code_language_invalid: Use a language name without spaces, for example python.
title: EdiMarkdown: Markdown text editor
app_loading_hint: A long document can take a few seconds.
startup_document_too_long: “{name}” was not opened because of its size: click its tab whenever you want it open.
app_loading_cancel_confirm: An empty session will open and the saved documents from the previous session will be discarded. This deletes no file on disk. Continue?
app_loading_cancel_late: The app had already finished opening: nothing was discarded.
desktop_window_btn_title: Open in a standalone window, with no tabs or address bar
doc_lang_btn_title: Options for the whole document: language, author, table of contents, and formatting.
doc_settings_modal_description: Defaults for every document. Each document can override them with its own options, saved with the file.
doc_settings_language_hint: Marks the language in all five formats: spell checking in DOCX and ODT, hyphenation in LaTeX and the language attribute in HTML and EPUB.
doc_settings_author_hint: Stored in the file properties, and shown in the EPUB and on the LaTeX title page. In DOCX and ODT a line with the name is also written at the start of the document. Leave it empty for no author.
doc_settings_toc_hint: Adds a table of contents at the start of the document, with the sections. In DOCX and ODT it is written ready to read, but without page numbers: to get those, refresh it in your program (in Word, right-click it → Update field; in LibreOffice, Tools → Update → Indexes). The EPUB does not need it: the reader already has its own.
doc_settings_numbering_hint: Numbers the headings (1, 1.1, 1.2…). ODT does not support this numbering and comes out without it.
doc_settings_cover_hint: The image shown on the shelf of the e-book reader. It only affects the EPUB.
doc_settings_cover_auto: Generated from the title and the author
doc_settings_cover_too_big: The image takes {size} and the limit is 1 MB. Try a smaller one.
doc_settings_cover_error: The image could not be read.
doc_settings_latex_section_hint: Applies when exporting to TEX and when copying LaTeX as a full document.
latex_settings_preamble_hint: Inserted verbatim at the end of the preamble. If it contains errors, the document will fail to compile.
menu_hint_import: From PDF, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML or TEX
menu_hint_save_as: Under another name or in another folder
menu_hint_quit: Saves the document and closes the application
menu_hint_spellcheck: Underlines mistakes using the system dictionaries
menu_hint_manual: Everything the application does, with examples
menu_hint_updates: Checks whether a newer version is available
menu_hint_theme_system: Follows the computer's and changes with it
footnote_text_help: You can use Markdown formatting inside the note.
export_menu_hint_html: Self-contained web page, with its styles
about_ai_text: Programmed in dialogue with AI assistants, among them Claude Code. The author decides what the program does and how it is used, tests every change on screen and fixes whatever does not work; every version also passes automated tests in Chromium and Firefox.
desktop_banner_message: EdiMarkdown Desktop {version} is available for Linux, Windows and macOS.
update_manual_download_message: EdiMarkdown {version} is available, but there is no installer for this system. Download it from the release page.
update_up_to_date: You already have the latest version ({version}).
update_ready_installer: The installer is now open. Close EdiMarkdown so it can replace the files, and open it again when it finishes.
update_ready_appimage: Downloaded to {path}. Close EdiMarkdown and replace your AppImage with this file.
no_content: There is no content to export.
images_not_embedded: Some images could not be downloaded and were left out of the exported document.
mermaid_unavailable: Mermaid could not be loaded to draw the diagram. Check your connection.
mermaid_export_failed: A diagram could not be drawn and was exported as code.
images_too_large: Some images are too large to embed and have been left out of the exported document. Their alt text has been kept.
ios_specific_advice: On iOS, if the issue persists, close and restart the browser.
formula_hint_block_dollar: Block, on a line of its own
edicuatex_popup_blocked: Allow pop-ups in your browser to use EdiCuaTeX.
sirena_popup_blocked: Allow pop-up windows in your browser to use Sirena.
sirena_not_found: The diagram changed in the document while it was being edited; the one from Sirena has been added as a new one.
desktop_window_popup_blocked: Allow pop-ups in your browser to open the standalone window.
reload_from_disk_btn_title_disabled: This tab is not saved to any file: there is nothing to reload.
reload_from_disk_unchanged: The file on disk has not changed.
reload_from_disk_confirm: “{name}” has unsaved changes. Reload the file from disk and discard them?
reload_from_disk_error: The file on disk could not be read.
preview_zoom_out_title: Zoom the page out (Ctrl+-); the document does not change
preview_zoom_in_title: Zoom the page in (Ctrl++); the document does not change
preview_zoom_in_capped_title: The sheet already fills the pane; release the switch beside it, or leave the preview on its own, to enlarge it further
preview_link_toggle_title: Tie the pane width to the zoom: the page always fits
export_btn_title_format: Export the document to {format} (Ctrl+Alt+E for the list)
copy_chord_hint: Copy: 1 Markdown · 2 HTML · 3 LaTeX · 4 full LaTeX · Esc cancels
copy_menu_markdown_hint: The source text, exactly as it stands in the editor
copy_menu_latex_hint: Just the fragment, to paste inside another document
copy_menu_latex_full_hint: With preamble and environment, ready to compile
copy_menu_html_hint: Pastes with formatting into word processors and editors
math_placement_block: As a block, on its own
math_preview_empty: Type the formula to see it here.
image_alt_text_help: With a caption, the image is centred in its own paragraph. It also describes the image for people who cannot see it.
image_clipboard_empty: The clipboard does not contain an image.
image_source_required: Choose or paste an image, or enter its address.
image_file_error: The selected image could not be read.
latex_import_modal_description: Paste a full LaTeX document. It will be converted to Markdown and replace the current content. Support is basic: advanced commands or external file references might be skipped.
import_file_error: The file could not be imported.
import_file_unsupported: File format not supported for import.
drop_title: Drop here to open in a new tab
drop_subtitle: Markdown (.md, .markdown) or PDF, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML and TEX documents. You can also drop several files or whole folders.
drop_unsupported: You can only drop Markdown files (.md, .markdown) or PDF, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML and TEX documents.
tab_location_unsaved: Not saved to any file: only in EdiMarkdown’s automatic copy.
footer_privacy_notice: Files are processed locally in this browser. The app collects no usage statistics and sends no files or data to third parties.
footer_privacy_notice_desktop: Files are processed locally on your computer. The app collects no usage statistics and sends no files or data to third parties. On its own it only connects to GitHub, to find out whether there is a new version: at startup, unless you untick “Check at startup” in the update notice, and when you ask for it from Help.
storage_unavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Changes will not be retained after you close the application.
storage_quota_exceeded: Local storage is full. Save the document to a file to avoid losing your changes.
storage_corrupt_recovered: The saved document list was damaged. A new session has been started so you can keep working.
base64_extract_one_btn_title: Writes this image as a file in the document folder and leaves its path in the text
base64_extract_btn: Move embedded images to the folder
base64_extract_btn_title: Writes each embedded image as a file in the document folder and leaves its path in the text
base64_extract_done_one: {count} image moved to “{folder}”. It will be written when you save the document.
base64_extract_done_many: {count} images moved to “{folder}”. They will be written when you save the document.
base64_extract_empty: There are no embedded images in this document.
base64_extract_error: The images could not be moved to the folder.
base64_extract_one_error: The image could not be moved to the folder.
base64_delete_confirm: Remove “{name}” from the document? This cannot be undone.
document_image_replace_btn_title: Choose another image from the clipboard, disk or internet
document_image_replace_error: The image to replace could not be found.
linked_image_embed_btn_title: Convert the image to Base64 inside the document
linked_image_embed_done: “{name}” has been embedded in the document.
linked_image_embed_error: The image could not be embedded in the document.
linked_image_read_error: The linked image could not be read.
base64_modal_description: The fragment remains hidden in the editor to save space. You can view or copy it here.
clipboard_button_unsupported: Your browser cannot read the clipboard from a button. Use Ctrl+V.
clipboard_read_error: The clipboard could not be read. Use Ctrl+V instead.
clipboard_empty_or_unsupported: The clipboard is empty or uses an unsupported format.
save_file_bundle_done: Document and resources saved in {name}; extract it to preserve their folders.
save_file_error: The document could not be saved.
open_file_error: The document could not be opened.
open_file_already_open_dirty: That document is already open and has unsaved changes: it is left as it is.
tab_menu_reveal_failed: The folder could not be opened. The file may have been moved or deleted.
missing_assets_one: One image in this document cannot be found.
missing_assets_many: {count} images in this document cannot be found.
missing_assets_folder_empty: That folder contains neither document images nor its bibliography.
image_insert_mode_relative_help: The image stays in its folder and the document just names it. The text stays small and the image can be replaced without touching it.
image_insert_mode_embedded_help: The image travels embedded in the file itself, which becomes self-contained but much heavier.
image_insert_mode_url_help: The document points to an image that lives online: it takes up no space, but it stops showing if that address changes or there is no connection.
image_insert_mode_unsaved_warning: This document has not been saved yet, so there is no folder to work the path out from: only the file name will be written. Save it next to the image or embed the image instead.
image_insert_mode_browser_warning: In the browser the image folder is unknown: only its name will be written, and the document will find it if both sit side by side.
image_insert_mode_outside_warning: The image is outside the document folder: the path climbs with “../” and will only work if both are moved together.
doc_format_modal_hint: Saved with the document. Anything left as “Inherited” uses the general value shown below.
doc_format_inherited_hint: Under each empty field you can see the value it inherits right now.
profile_hint: A profile keeps the text, page and table-of-contents settings so you can reuse them in another document. Applying it only fills the fields: nothing changes until you press “Apply”.
profile_empty: This document has no settings of its own to save as a profile.
profile_delete_confirm: Delete the profile “{name}”? Documents that used it do not change.
doc_format_open_general_hint: Closes this dialog without applying changes and opens the general options.
doc_format_inherited_none: Not set: whichever program opens the document decides.
doc_format_status_unset_hint: — : not set, whichever program opens the document decides.
citation_modal_description: Select one or more references. They will be inserted using Pandoc Markdown syntax.
citation_no_library: No bibliography has been loaded yet.
citation_style_summary: Citations will be composed in {style} style.
citation_preview_edit: Bibliographic citation. Press to edit it.
citation_mode_hint: Narrative and year-only citations require a single reference.
citation_locator_hint: Available when a single reference is selected.
citation_print_preparing: Resolving citations for the PDF, please wait...
citation_print_error: The citations could not be resolved; the unprocessed preview will be printed.
bibliography_hint: Load a BibTeX (.bib) or CSL JSON library. On save it will travel as document-name/references.bib and be declared in the Markdown.
bibliography_reference_form_hint: Expand the loaded library or create a new one. Separate multiple authors with semicolons.
bibliography_article_form_hint: Expand the loaded library or create a new one. Separate multiple authors with semicolons.
bibliography_article_key_hint: Leave it empty and one will be generated automatically
bibliography_article_invalid_key: The key must start with a letter or number and cannot contain spaces.
bibliography_article_duplicate_key: A reference with that key already exists.
bibliography_too_big: The bibliography is {size} and exceeds the 2 MB limit.
bibliography_invalid: The file does not contain a valid BibTeX or CSL JSON library.
bibliography_local_hint: The bibliography and a custom style are saved alongside the document for portability. Nothing is sent to any service.
csl_hint: APA 7 is the default. Choose another included style or load your own CSL file.
csl_too_big: The CSL style is {size} and exceeds the 1 MB limit.
csl_invalid: The file does not contain a valid CSL style.
doc_own_outline_hint: The table of contents goes at the start of the exported document; the EPUB does not need one, because the reader already has its own. ODT does not support section numbering.
doc_settings_format_section_hint: Starting values for every document. Each document can set its own from the Markdown pane.
doc_language_status_own: This document's language: {code}. Click to change it.
doc_language_status_inherited: Language inherited from the general options: {code}. Click to give it one of its own.
doc_format_status_hint: This is how it will export or print. Click to change it.
doc_format_font_custom_hint: The suggestions are the installed typefaces that could be recognised.
doc_format_font_system_btn: Show every typeface on this computer…
doc_format_font_system_ready: Every typeface on this computer is now suggested.
doc_format_font_system_denied: The system list could not be read; type the name by hand.
doc_format_font_missing: “{font}” does not seem to be installed here: the document keeps it anyway and it will look right on a computer that has it; here it falls back to another typeface.
doc_format_field_pagebreak_h1: Start each H1 on a new page
preview_unpaginated: The document is too long to split into pages: the preview is shown as one flow. What you export is unchanged.
preview_on_demand: This document is long and building the preview takes a while, so it is not built on its own. You can write, save and export without it.
preview_on_demand_working: Building the preview… The app will not respond meanwhile.
preview_stale: The preview does not follow your typing in this document: rebuilding it takes too long.
doc_format_hyphenate_hint: Hyphenation uses the system dictionaries: on Linux, LibreOffice needs the language package (hyphen-en, for instance).
latex_margins_dropped: The preamble already loads geometry, so the margins or orientation from the document formatting were not applied to the TEX file.
pdf_note: Local conversion. OCR turns scanned pages into editable text. Review the result: tables, formulas, images, and watermarks may affect recognition or reading order.
pdf_keep_images: Keep images and detected formulas as images
pdf_preview_images_hidden_one: There is 1 more image not shown here, but it will be imported all the same.
pdf_preview_images_hidden_many: {count} further images are not shown here, but they will be imported all the same.
pdf_preview_truncated: The preview shows only the beginning of the document, which is imported whole.
pdf_changed: The options have changed. Convert again.
pdf_document_long: A document this long can take several minutes to convert.
pdf_document_scanned_one: 1 of them looks scanned (page {pages}): tick OCR if you want its text instead of the image.
pdf_document_scanned_many: {scanned} of them look scanned (pages {pages}): tick OCR if you want their text instead of the images.
pdf_loading: Loading the local converter (about 34 MB the first time)…
pdf_scanning_page: Analysing headers and footers… page {page} of {total}
pdf_mounting: Preparing the document in the new tab…
pdf_ocr_loading: Loading local text recognition for the first time…
pdf_error: Could not convert the PDF. Check the file and generate the preview again.
pdf_pages_invalid: Invalid page range or pages outside the document. For example: 1-3, 5.
pdf_password: This PDF is password protected. Open a copy without a password.
pdf_size_limit: The PDF exceeds the 50 MB limit.
pdf_empty: No content was recovered. This PDF may need OCR.
pdf_partial: Some pages have no extractable text. Review the result; OCR was disabled.
pdf_ocr_ready: OCR complete. Review possible recognition errors before importing.
pdf_ocr_error: OCR could not be completed. Check the connection in the web version or try again.
pdf_ready: Conversion finished. Review the content before importing it.
menu_hint_storage: How much the documents and their images take up
storage_modal_description: What EdiMarkdown keeps in this browser: the text of the open tabs and the images of their documents. None of it leaves your computer.
storage_purge_btn: Delete the images with no document
storage_forget_confirm: The tabs will be closed and the text saved for this session will be discarded, along with its images. This deletes no file on disk. Continue?
storage_purge_empty: There was no image without a document.
storage_purge_failed: The images could not be deleted.
storage_read_failed: The storage could not be read.
document_image_locate_btn_title: Take the cursor to where the image is in the document
document_image_locate_error: The image could not be found in the text.
linked_embed_all_btn_title: Puts inside the document every image that is linked from a file or a web address
linked_image_embed_all_failed_one: One image could not be embedded.
app_loading_preview_blocking: Laying out the page… The application will not respond until it finishes.
